description: Construction of residential building on the site of Ergon House of nine storeys above ground to provide up to 108 residential units, provision of ground floor level retail unit (Class A1) and associated basement works, Deed of Variation to the S106 legal agreement for planning permission 13/09737/FULL in order to apply relevant provisions to this current application. (9 Millbank and The Gatehouse, Dean Bradley Street and demolition of Ergon House to be implemented under planning permission reference 13/09737/FULL).
